You were hiding in the bunker.|Crab|That's a lie.|Rika|I saw you.|Rowd|Yeah, you tell him, Rika.|Gerdis|Step off, Rowd!|attr=Rika, Crab, Rowd, and Gerdis argue about what happened during the ambush|audio=HidingInTheBunker-OneYearLater.flac|src=}} '''Rowd''' was a [[human]] member of the [[Maya Pei Brigade]] when it was [[Ambush of the Maya Pei Brigade|ambushed]] in [[4 BBY]]. He was among a group of sixteen survivors who made it to the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]], where [[Bardi's brother|one]] member of the group left them stranded while claiming that he was taking their [[Starship|ship]] to search for survivors. The fifteen remaining survivors encountered and [[Death|killed]] the [[Axis network]] [[pilot]] [[Porko]] after he shot at them. When Porko's comrade [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] arrived on Yavin 4 in a stolen [[TIE Avenger prototype|TIE Avenger]], Rowd and the other survivors took him captive but realized only he could fly the [[starfighter]]. The group argued about what to do with Andor and the [[TIE series|TIE]], leading to the brigade member [[Crab (individual)|Crab]] shooting the group's pilot, [[Rika]]. Rowd shot Crab in return, and the brigade split into two factions, with Rowd joining a group led by the brigade member [[Bardi]] that hid in the TIE Avenger while the group led by his rival [[Gerdis]] took Andor with them and hid in a wrecked [[Breon HOY-39 Dayvan|ship]] nearby. After both groups sent out [[scout]]s to try and find Rika and Crab's remains, Rowd cut open a [[Yavin 4 melon]] to try and find a food source for his stranded faction. Bardi's group then began slowly turning the TIE Avenger to face the hiding place of Gerdis's group so they could use its weapons on them. That [[Local day|night]], Gerdis called out a challenge to Bardi and the two factions met between the two ships for a game of [[Five Hands]] to decide their differences. Bardi chose Rowd as his second, and Gerdis chose the brigade member [[Bayso]], with the four of them playing several rounds of the game. They stopped at the sound of rumbling, and a [[Yavinian doodar]] emerged from the nearby [[tree]]s and snatched Gerdis and Bardi. Rowd was knocked to the ground but joined the others in firing in the doodar's direction, turning their fire to the TIE Avenger when the brigade member [[Flek]] warned them that Andor had escaped. Their fire did little to the TIE, and Andor was able to take off in the starfighter, leaving Rowd and the others stranded once again. ==Biography== ===Ambushed=== {{Quote|We got ambushed. We lost 6 ships, 40 fighters.|Gerdis|audio=Gerdis-Ambushed-OneYearLater.flac|}} Rowd was a [[human]] who served as part of the rebellious [[Maya Pei Brigade]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[4 BBY]], the brigade was [[Ambush of the Maya Pei Brigade|ambushed]], losing six [[starship]]s and forty [[starfighter]]s. Rowd was among a group of sixteen survivors who escaped and made it to the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]],''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' where they came upon the [[pilot]] [[Porko]], who was a member of the rebel [[Axis network]], waiting at a rendezvous point. He shot at them and tried to flee, so they [[Death|killed]] him. The survivors' self-proclaimed leader, [[Gerdis]], claimed to have seen [[Maya Pei]], the leader of the brigade, perish during the ambush, but the [[Bardi's brother|brother]] of fellow survivor [[Bardi]] took their ship and left Yavin, claiming that he was going to search for survivors. [[File:AndorPrisoner-OneYearLater.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Crab and Rowd stand either side of Cassian Andor holding him by the arms as he kneels before Gerdis and Bardi. Behind the prisoner, Tick aims a blaster pistol at his head.|Rowd and the Maya Pei Brigade captured Cassian Andor on Yavin 4.]] Two [[Local day|days]] after they had arrived at the rendezvous point, Bardi's [[Gender|brother]] had not returned to the stranded rebels, but a [[TIE Avenger prototype|TIE Avenger]] appeared overhead, and Rowd and the other surviving brigade members hid in the undergrowth nearby. When the starfighter's pilot, [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], landed and emerged, Gerdis called out to him and told him he was surrounded by the fifteen of them. Bardis began arguing with Gerdis about revealing their numbers to the new arrival, who claimed not to be an Imperial and surrendered. The brigade members emerged and put Andor in [[Stuncuffs|binders]], with Rowd and brigade member [[Crab (individual)|Crab]] lifting him from the ground so that Gerdis could question him. Instead of getting answers, Gerdis and Bardi began arguing again, and Andor began questioning them about what happened to Porko. The brigade's only pilot, [[Rika]], discovered a [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|TIE pilot]] [[Flight helmet|helmet]] and brought it before the rest of the group as evidence that Andor was an Imperial. ===A broken brigade=== {{Quote|Your brother dumped us here and ran away, and you wanna talk about trust?''"
"''He went back for survivors.''"
"''Nobody believes that.''"
"''Rika, Neek, Nazy, Rowd… Oh, we know what really happened.|Gerdis and Bardi|audio=BardisBrother-OneYearLater.flac |}} [[File:SeatedBrigade-OneYearLater.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Most members of the Maya Pei Brigade sit outside the wrecked Breon HOY-39 on Yavin 4.|The Maya Pei Brigade debated what to do with Andor and the TIE Avenger.]] Rowd and fellow brigade member [[Tick (individual)|Tick]] wandered near the Avenger as Gerdis, Bardi, and Rika inspected the inside with Andor and realized that only Andor could pilot the ship. Rowd and his comrade [[Musk]] gathered at the starfighter's [[entry ramp]] as the brigade member [[Plug]] asked those inside if there was anything to eat on board. With Crab guarding Andor elsewhere, Rowd and the rest of the group gathered to discuss what to do with the Avenger. When the option of taking multiple trips on it to get off the moon was raised, Gerdis and Bardi began arguing about if Bardi's brother had abandoned them, with Gerdis claiming no one believed he was coming back. Bardi named Rowd, Rika, [[Neek]], and [[Nazy]] as brigade members who knew the truth before Andor interrupted, having learned who the rebels were from Crab. ===Revenge for Rika=== {{Quote|Skug!|Rowd shoots Crab|audio=Rowd-Skug-OneYearLater.flac|}} Andor, who was also part of the Axis network, revealed that he and Porko had been stealing the Avenger for the rebels and that they had supplied the Maya Pei Brigade in the past, although he refused to reveal [[Luthen Rael|who]] specifically within the rebellion he worked for. He was taken away and guarded while Rowd, Rika, Crab, Bardi, and Gerdis entered the Avenger's [[cockpit]]. While Gerdis and Bardi argued about what to do with Andor, Rika discussed the starfighter's controls with Rowd and Crab. Rika pressed a button and accidentally activated the ship's [[blaster cannon]]s. After night fell, the whole group gathered again and began arguing about who was in charge, with Gerdis claiming that he{{Andor|One Year Later}} {{AD|Disney+}} was leader, as he had always been Pei's number two. [[File:RowdKillsCrab-OneYearLater.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Red light washes over Rowd's face as he blasts Crab in the chest during the night on Yavin 4.|Rowd shot Crab in retaliation for the death of Rika.]] Rowd objected that he wanted to hear from Pei herself, but Gerdis and Crab countered that she was dead, which Nazy and Rika objected to, with Rika claiming that Crab had seen nothing in the ambush as he hid in a bunker. Rowd backed Rika against Crab, with Gerdis telling Rowd to back off, but as the others tried to continue the discussion, Crab drew his [[blaster]] on Rika and demanded she repeat the claim and call him a liar. Gerdis tried to calm Crab, but failed, and when Rika taunted Crab, he shot her. Calling Crab a [[skug]], Rowd shot him in the chest, and a gunfight broke out among the survivors. ===Yavin standoff=== {{Dialogue|Tick|Eat it.|Flu|Why me?|Musk|You'll eat anything. You ate those trogs.|Flu|That was a dare.|Rowd|Okay, I dare you.|attr=Bardi's faction of the Maya Pei Brigade discuss eating a Yavin 4 melon|audio=Trogs-SagronaTeema.flac|src={{Andor|Sagrona Teema}}}} Rowd and a group led by Bardi fell back toward the [[TIE series|TIE Avenger]], while Gerdis and his followers fell back to a wrecked [[Breon HOY-39 Dayvan]] with Andor. With both groups hiding in the ships, it began to [[Water|rain]], and each faction sent a member out to crawl through the battlefield and try to find out if Rika and Crab had survived. Bardi's group sent out Nazy, and when he had not returned after some time, Rowd asked Bardi if he had seen anything. Nazy shouted back that there was nothing to find, but Bardi urged him to continue and began blaming Gerdis's group for having stolen Rika's body. [[File:RowdDare-SagronaTeema.png|thumb|right|350px|alt=Rowd leans toward Bardi and Flu, the latter of whom is holding a cut open Yavin 4 melon.|Rowd dared Flu to eat a Yavin 4 melon after he refused due to the smell.]] [[Snee]], who Gerdis's group had sent out to search, discovered Crab's severed [[Limb|foot]], all that remained of him after the creatures of Yavin had found his body. When Snee called out in horror, Nazy shot at her and began fleeing back toward the TIE Avenger as Rowd, Bardi, and Tick provided covering fire. Nazy revealed Rika's [[goggles]] to Rowd and the others, claiming it was all that was left. The next morning, fog descended between the two opposing factions of the brigade as each tried to find something to [[Diet|eat]]. Rowd split open a [[Yavin 4 melon]] with a [[machete]], producing a smell that caused the other members of the group to retch and recoil, and threw part of it to the brigade member [[Flu (individual)|Flu]]. Flu refused to eat it and threw it to Tick, but Musk pointed out that Flu would usually eat anything and brought up his consumption of [[Trog-beast|trogs]]. Flu objected that he had only eaten the trogs because he was dared, so Rowd dared Flu to eat the [[melon]]. Bardi grabbed the [[Fruit|melon]], hesitated, and took a bite. ===Turning a TIE=== {{Dialogue|Musk|It moved!|Nazy|Check it.|Bardi|Rowd?|Rowd|Another few centimeters.|attr=Bardi's faction shifts the TIE Avenger|audio=TIEAvenger-Measurement-SagronaTeema.flac|src=}} [[File:RowdMeasurement-SagronaTeema.png|thumb|left|325px|alt=Rowd squints at a vine while kneeling down in order to measure how far his allies have turned the TIE Avenger on Yavin 4.|Rowd and his allies tried to turn the TIE Avenger to face Gerdis's faction.]] Bardi's faction tied ropes to the wing of the TIE Avenger and began working as a team to turn the ship toward Gerdis's faction. Gritting his [[Tooth|teeth]] with effort, Rowd pulled on the wing while others used [[Tree|branches]] for leverage. When Musk cried out that the ship had moved, Bardi had Rowd check their progress, and, using a [[vine]] to test his sightline, he confirmed that they shifted the Avenger a few [[centimeter]]s. The group began pulling again but were interrupted by blaster fire from Gerdis's group, who had learned of Bardi's faction's plan. Rowd returned fire while falling back into cover, crouching behind a branch. That night, Gerdis began yelling discouragement at Bardi's group while the latter sat around a [[Fire|campfire]] by the TIE. When their foe mentioned they would not be able to survive on the Yavin 4 [[Foodstuff|melons]], Rowd questioned how their opponents knew about the food source, with Flu correctly concluding that they had sent [[scout]]s to sneak up and spy on them. Gerdis issued a challenge to Bardi, and both groups emerged from their ships to meet at the center of the rendezvous point, weapons raised. Andor was left in the Breon HOY-39 guarded by the brigade member [[Flek]]. ===Seconds to disaster=== {{Quote|Pick your second.''"
"''Rowd, step up.|Gerdis and Bardi|audio=Gerdis-Bardi-Seconds-SagronaTeema.flac|}} [[File:RowdFiveHands-SagronaTeema.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Rowd stares intently while playing Five Hands, with Gerdis's raised hand to his right and Bardi to his left.|Rowd acted as Bardi's second while playing Five Hands on Yavin 4.]] Gripping his weapon and a [[lantern]], Rowd stared at his rivals with a hostile look as they approached. Both groups agreed to drop their weapons, doing so slowly and deliberately as Gerdis counted down from three. Bardi and Gerdis agreed to play a game of [[Five Hands]] using [[Roski rules]] to decide their conflict. Bardi chose Rowd as his second, while Gerdis picked the brigade member [[Bayso]]. Moving up beside Bardi and Gerdis, Rowd stared Bayso down, and the pair began pounding their fists into their palms. Bardi and Gerdis joined in, and on a count of three, all four presented hand signals, with the group repeating this twice more before declaring a tie. After a second tied round, Andor subdued Flek and escaped in the undergrowth toward the TIE Avenger as the game continued. The group paused at the sound of rumbling from the nearby trees, moving to investigate before a [[Yavinian doodar]] charged into them and grabbed Gerdis and Bardi in its [[Mouth|jaws]] before continuing into the foliage. Having been knocked to the ground by the creature, Rowd cried out directions as the other brigade members opened fire in the direction the doodar had left. [[File:MayaPeiBrigadeStranded-SagronaTeema.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Rowd, Flek, Nazy, Neek, Tick, Snee, Bayso, and Snur look up in dispair as they are left stranded in the dark jungle of Yavin 4 by Cassian Andor.|Rowd and the other Maya Pei Brigade survivors were left stranded on Yavin 4.]] Flek broke free of the binds Andor had put on him and rushed to warn the others of the pilot's escape, causing Rowd and the others to turn their fire on the TIE Avenger as Andor shot Flu inside and began to take off. The group's blasters merely bounced off the ship, and they soon stopped firing as Andor piloted the vessel off of Yavin, leaving Rowd and the others stranded once again. Andor's encounter with the Maya Pei Brigade on Yavin 4 showed him how far the rebellion was from acting as an organized force.{{SWYouTube|5SdMzzmeNsY|Andor Season 2 Declassified: Time}} ==Personality and traits== {{Dialogue|Rowd|I wanna hear it from Maya.|Gerdis|That might take a while.|Crab|She's dead.|attr=Rowd, Gerdis, and Crab argue about leadership of the surviving May Pei Brigade members|audio=HearFromMaya-OneYearLater.flac|src=}} Rowd refused to believe Gerdis's claim that Maya Pei had died and backed Rika against him and Crab when they argued about it, killing Crab in revenge when he shot Rika. He sided with Bardi when the brigade survivors split and was chosen as his second when the rival factions faced off in a game of Five Hands. Rowd had light skin, [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], and blue [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== {{Quote|You can stop right there! You got 15 blasters pointed at you right now!|Gerdis warns Andor|audio=Gerdis-15Blasters-OneYearLater.flac|}} On Yavin 4, Rowd carried a [[blaster rifle]] and wore a gray [[Clothing|vest]] with a black [[scarf]], a green [[jacket]], green pants, a brown [[belt]], and black [[boot]]s. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:JackBandeira-IMDB.jpg|thumb|right|300px|alt=Jack Bandeira poses for a photo in a white shirt.|Jack Bandeira portrayed Rowd in ''Andor''.]] Rowd was portrayed by [[Jack Bandeira]] in the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in "[[One Year Later]]" and [[Sagrona Teema]]," the first and second episodes of the show's [[Andor Season 2|second season]], which both aired on [[April 22]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} The Yavin jungle clearing scenes involving the Maya Pei Brigade were shot at [[Wikipedia:Longcross Studios|Longcross Studios]].{{SW|url=news/andor-trivia-guide-week-4|text=Secrets from the Set of ''Andor'' Season 2: Week 4 Trivia}} Costume designer [[Michael Wilkinson]] and concept artist [[Glyn Dillon]] worked on the costumes for the Maya Pei Brigade, treating them as threadbare survivalists who needed to contrast from the luxury refinement of costumes on [[Chandrila]], the sophistication of costumes on [[Coruscant]], and the agricultural workwear of [[Mina-Rau]], all other settings on the show.{{Instagram|username=michaelwilkinson|url=p/DLVGZ5Ox7tE|name=[[Michael Wilkinson]]|date=2025-06-25|quote=For the threadbare survivalists of the #MayaPei gang, the costumes we created needed to seem far from the luxury and refinement of #Chandrila, the urbane sophistication of #Coruscant, and the agricultural workwear of #MinaRau. Illustrations by @glyn_dillon #costumedesign #starwars #andor #andorofficial #fashion #cdg892 #fyc costumes|archiveurl=https://archive.is/IGILm|archivefile=File:MichaelWilkinson-MayaPeiBrigade-Image1-Instagram.png|archivefile2=File:MichaelWilkinson-MayaPeiBrigade-Image2-Instagram.png|archivefile3=File:MichaelWilkinson-MayaPeiBrigade-Image3-Instagram.png|archivefile4=File:MichaelWilkinson-MayaPeiBrigade-Image4-Instagram.png|archivefile5=File:MichaelWilkinson-MayaPeiBrigade-Image5-Instagram.png|archivefile6=File:MichaelWilkinson-MayaPeiBrigade-Image6-Instagram.png|archivefile7=File:MichaelWilkinson-MayaPeiBrigade-Image7-Instagram.png}} Rowd and the other brigade members were made to appear sweaty and grubby by{{Instagram|username=michaelwilkinson|url=s/aGlnaGxpZ2h0OjE3OTgzODQzMjAyODMwNDky?story_media_id=3663534388310792388|name=[[Michael Wilkinson]]|date=2025-06-26|quote=Maya Pei brigade Made sweaty and grubby by the mighty Jackie Moody and her amazing breakdown team|archivefile=File:MichaelWilkinson-GrubbyMayaPeiBrigade-InstagramReel.png}} chief textile artist [[Jackie Moody]] and her breakdown team. Prior to the release of the episodes, Rowd was revealed in the first public trailer for the series on [[February 24]], 2025.{{SWYouTube|AE4wxt70aUM|Andor | Season 2 Trailer | Streaming April 22 on Disney+}} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Rowd|imagecat=Images of Rowd}} *{{Andor|One Year Later}} {{1st}} *{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|AE4wxt70aUM|Andor | Season 2 Trailer | Streaming April 22 on Disney+}} {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|6XL5uHQTKo4|Andor | Cassian Andor | Final Season Streaming April 22 on Disney+}} *{{SWYouTube|q0trVP56Cy0|Star Wars Celebration LIVE! 2025 - DAY 2}} *{{SWYouTube|WUpflQHbJhc|Andor Season 2 | We Ask the Questions | Now Streaming on Disney+}} *{{InsiderCite|233|Andor Season 2 Companion|''Andor'' Season 2 Companion}} {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Rowd |ja=ラウド |ka=როუდი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Members of Maya Pei Brigade]]
